near_threshold_margin_analysis.rationale: 0.05 is less than half the smallest real separation observed in either direction (unchecked: exactly 0.12, constant; checked: minimum 0.124), so it cannot fire on any of this benchmark's 600 real documents, while remaining wide enough to catch a genuinely ambiguous real-world interior ink ratio (roughly 0.07-0.17) that this synthetic dataset does not produce. See docs/experiments/phase8c12-checkbox-validator.md Section 2.

provenance: Phase 8C.10 checkbox_anchor.py output, unmodified by Phase 8C.11 (no retuning); Phase 8C.11's own production-path benchmark independently confirmed the identical 600/600 localization and 0/600 fallback result this file reports.

questions.1_observed_margin_distribution: Unchecked: constant -0.12 (interior_ink_ratio always exactly 0.0, n=240). Checked: +0.124 to +0.178 (n=360). A clean, unbroken 0.244-wide gap between the two classes with nothing observed inside it -- this dataset offers no real near-boundary example in either direction.
questions.2_observed_shape_score_distribution: 0.8269-0.8800 across all 600 documents (tight, resolution/DPI-specific to this one synthetic renderer).
questions.3_rotated_docs_systematically_weaker_geo: Slightly: rotated_png mean shape_score 0.8334 vs. 0.8667 for the other three variants, and rotated_png shows the largest alignment_offset_px (2-3px vs. 0-1.5px elsewhere) -- consistent with the rotation-induced OCR line-box noise the phase 8C.10 doc's 'Real Geometry Investigation' section describes, but still far above any plausible malformed-geometry floor.
questions.4_correct_docs_near_plausible_uncertaint: No: the closest any correct document comes to the chosen 0.05 margin threshold is 0.12 (the unchecked constant), 2.4x the threshold. 0 of 600 documents fall inside the chosen 0.05 threshold (see near_threshold_margin_analysis).
questions.5_would_proposed_thresholds_produce_fals: No at 0.05 (0 of 600 flagged; see near_threshold_margin_analysis for thresholds that WOULD start flagging correct documents -- notably anything >= 0.12 flags all 240 unchecked documents, since their margin is a hard constant at exactly -0.12).
questions.6_which_rules_are_evidence_backed_vs_spe: Evidence-backed: detection_method/fallback_used (Phase 8C.10's own 600/600 vs. 540/600 A/B result), anchor_found/checkbox_found (Phase 8C.10's 600/600 localization result), decision_margin at 0.05 (this analysis's gap measurement). Structural-only, not benchmark-fit: shape_score's 0.5 floor (a broad plausibility bound, deliberately far from this benchmark's own 0.827-0.880 range so it does not overfit one renderer). Deferred, insufficient variation: anchor_distance_px and horizontal_alignment_offset_px numeric thresholds -- both are raw, non-normalized pixel offsets specific to one 2550x3300 synthetic render DPI, preserved as signals but not used in a production rule this phase.
